question.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $W$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $[3,11],$ compute $P(W\ge 7).$
question.worked_solution:
The probability density function for a uniformly distributed continuous random variable $W$ on an interval $[a,b]$ is given by

$$
f(w)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{b-a},\, & a\le w\le b, \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise.}\end{aligned}
$$

Our random variable $W$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $[3,11],$ so it has the following probability density function:

$$
f(w)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{8},\, & 3\le w\le 11, \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise.}\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(W\ge 7) & =P(7\le W\le 11) \\  & ={\int }_{7}^{11}f(w)\,\text{d}w \\  & ={\int }_{7}^{11}\frac{1}{8}\,\text{d}w \\  & =\frac{11-7}{8} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
